summary: Implemented Graph.cbd(resource) in rdflib/graph.py as the last Graph method, before ConjunctiveGraph. It follows the three CBD rules: subject triples with blank-node recursion guarded by the result's existing subject triples, then rdf:subject reifiers with all their triples and no rdf:Statement or predicate/object matching. Added test/test_graph_cbd.py with CbdTestCase covering counts (6, 2, 3, 0), typed reifier (8), untyped reifier (13), incoming reification exclusion, blank node in reifier not expanded, blank-node cycle (3), and source immutability. Tests were not run and no repository code was executed, so all expected counts are hand-computed and unverified. Nothing was committed and no documentation page was added.
